description: Branch counter sales, quotes, pricing, distribution center picking, delivery, and invoicing for contractor customers (72 branches, 4 distribution centers)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $8.2 million of sales per business day; contractors switch suppliers within a day or two; job-site deliveries are scheduled the day before
manual_workaround: Paper tickets and price books printed nightly; cash and card sales on standalone terminals; deliveries from the printed route plan
dependent_systems: SYS-10 distribution system; SYS-01; SYS-04; SYS-08
dependent_third_parties: Distribution software vendor; card processor; SD-WAN carriers
quantified_impact_basis: About 70% of daily sales lost or deferred ($5.7M of $8.2M), most of it recovered later at lower margin
acquired_business_dependency: AQ-02 branches (9) run on their own ERP and directory (BP-16)

business_process: Building Products e-commerce and contractor portal
description: Online ordering, account statements, and order status for about 18,000 contractor accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 11% of Building Products sales are placed online; customers can call branches instead
manual_workaround: Customers call or visit branches; branch staff key orders
dependent_systems: SYS-10 e-commerce; SYS-01; SYS-07 Cloud B
quantified_impact_basis: Online orders deferred to branches; about $0.9M of orders a day at risk of loss to competitors

business_process: Home Services dispatch and field service
description: Booking, dispatch, technician mobile work orders, parts, and on-site payment for about 9,500 service calls a day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No-heat and no-cooling calls in summer and winter affect elderly and medically vulnerable customers; about 9,500 calls a day; technicians idle without work orders
manual_workaround: Branch dispatchers assign calls by phone from printed schedules; paper work orders; payments taken later
dependent_systems: SYS-10 field-service system; SYS-04; SYS-09 tablets; SYS-08
dependent_third_parties: Field-service SaaS vendor (contract RTO 8 h); telephony provider; card processor
quantified_impact_basis: About 80% of daily revenue ($2.9M) deferred or lost, plus technician idle time
acquired_business_dependency: AQ-01 branches (7) dispatch on their own system

description: Production scheduling, machine control, quality checks, and genealogy at 3 plants through the MES and plant OT
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Lines stop without MES work orders and quality records; a cyber event in OT can create unsafe machine states; about $5.5 million of shipments per business day
manual_workaround: Lines run on local controller programs for up to one shift with paper travelers; quality holds on all output until records are reconciled
dependent_systems: SYS-10 MES; SYS-11 plant OT; SYS-01; SYS-08
dependent_third_parties: MES vendor; robotics and controls integrators (remote support)
quantified_impact_basis: About 90% of daily shipments ($5.5M) stop after one shift; overtime to recover
single_points_of_failure: Plant 3 OT network is flat (one compromise can stop the plant)

description: Purchase orders, advance ship notices, and invoices with suppliers and distributors through EDI; shipping and carrier tendering
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Parts inventory covers about 3 days; distributors accept late shipments within a week
manual_workaround: Supplier portals and email for urgent orders; manual bills of lading
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-10 MES; EDI integrations on the integration platform
quantified_impact_basis: Expedited freight and line starvation after inventory runs out

business_process: Finance loan origination and dealer financing platform (SL-1)
description: Credit applications, decisions, documents, and funding for about 1,400 dealers and Home Services; about 1,900 applications a day
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Dealers close sales at the customer's kitchen table and switch to other lenders the same day; SL-1 contracts commit to 99.9% monthly availability (P09)
manual_workaround: None at scale; dealers may submit urgent applications by phone to Finance underwriting (about 5% of volume)
dependent_systems: SYS-10 loan platform; SL-1 dealer portal (SYS-07 Cloud B); SYS-04
quantified_impact_basis: Lost originations margin, dealer service credits, and dealer attrition (about $4.3M of loans a day)

business_process: Finance loan servicing, payments, and collections
description: Payment posting, ACH debits, borrower self-service, collections, and statements for about 210,000 loans
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Misapplied or late payment posting harms borrowers and creates consumer protection exposure; ACH files have bank cut-off times
manual_workaround: Payments held in suspense and posted after recovery; collections calls paused; no late fees for the outage period
dependent_systems: SYS-10 servicing platform; SYS-03 payment hub; SYS-04
dependent_third_parties: Bank (ACH origination); payment processor; print and mail vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Fee waivers, remediation, and call volume; about $0.6M a day
single_points_of_failure: Single ACH originating bank for loan payments

description: Wires, ACH, and checks for suppliers, payroll funding, intercompany settlements, and debt service through the payment hub (about $1.1 billion a week)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Supplier and payroll payments have bank cut-off times; missed debt service is a default event
manual_workaround: Bank portals with dual approval for priority payments (payroll, taxes, debt service); manual positive pay files
dependent_third_parties: Six banks (host-to-host); treasury management SaaS vendor
quantified_impact_basis: Late fees, lost discounts, and supplier holds; payroll or debt service failure would be Severe
acquired_business_dependency: 3 local bank portals outside the hub (Home Services and AQ-02)
single_points_of_failure: Primary bank carries 64% of payment value

description: Weekly payroll for about 8,900 hourly employees and biweekly payroll for salaried staff in 6 employer entities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wage payment deadlines under state and federal law; employee hardship; union-free workforce relies on timely pay
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior pay file through the payment hub and true up next cycle; off-cycle checks
dependent_third_parties: HRIS and payroll SaaS vendor; payroll funding bank
quantified_impact_basis: Penalties, off-cycle processing, and overtime; mostly reputational and legal exposure
acquired_business_dependency: AQ-01 payroll still runs on its own provider until 2027-01

description: GBS accounts payable: about 38,000 invoices a week, vendor master maintenance, and three-way match
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payment terms allow a few days of delay; vendor master integrity matters more than speed
manual_workaround: Priority invoices paid through bank portals with dual approval; others queued
quantified_impact_basis: Late fees and lost early-payment discounts
acquired_business_dependency: Home Services branch payables for small vendors (local)

business_process: Financial close, consolidation, and SEC reporting
description: Monthly close, quarterly and annual consolidation, SEC filings, and disclosure checklists
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines (10-Q, 10-K); at quarter-end the MTD falls to 48 hours
manual_workaround: Trial balances exported from the ERP and consolidated in controlled spreadsheets with second review
quantified_impact_basis: Overtime and advisers; a missed filing would be Severe
acquired_business_dependency: AQ-01 and AQ-02 results arrive by manual upload

business_process: HR, benefits, and group health plan administration
description: Hiring, onboarding, terminations, benefits enrollment, and plan administration with the TPA
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Enrollment changes and terminations can wait days; termination feeds drive access removal
manual_workaround: Paper onboarding; termination lists sent to the identity team by secure email
quantified_impact_basis: Administrative cost; late terminations raise security risk (P01 R-012)
acquired_business_dependency: AQ-01 and AQ-02 terminations processed by hand

description: Telemetry, fault alerts, and dashboards for about 38,000 commercial rooftop units owned by about 650 commercial customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers rely on alerts for equipment failures in occupied buildings; SL-2 contracts commit to 99.5% monthly availability
manual_workaround: Units keep running on local controls; customers check equipment on site; alerts replayed after recovery
dependent_third_parties: Cellular connectivity provider; Cloud provider B
quantified_impact_basis: Service credits and customer site visits

description: Home Services booking line and Finance servicing line (about 41,000 calls a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Booking calls are Home Services revenue; borrowers need to reach servicing
manual_workaround: Calls routed to branch phones; recorded message with self-service options
dependent_third_parties: Contact center SaaS vendor; telephony carriers

description: Board and committee materials, investor communications, and deal data rooms
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Board meetings are scheduled weeks ahead; MNPI must stay protected more than available
manual_workaround: Encrypted documents sent through the secure file transfer service
dependent_third_parties: Board portal vendor; data room vendor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Corporate secretary; investor relations; corporate development

business_process: AQ-01 and AQ-02 operations on legacy systems
description: Sales, service, and accounting at the 16 acquired branches on their own directories and ERPs until migration
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: BIA targets are RTO 24 h and RPO 1 h; actual capability is nightly backups (RPO 24 h) and a 48-hour vendor RTO at AQ-02
manual_workaround: Paper tickets; manual dispatch at AQ-01 branches
dependent_third_parties: AQ-02 hosted ERP vendor; AQ-01 managed service provider
quantified_impact_basis: About $0.8M of daily sales at AQ-02 and $0.3M at AQ-01 at risk
single_points_of_failure: Each AQ runs one unreplicated ERP

business_process: Email, collaboration, and the AI assistant
description: Email, files, chat, meetings, and the generative AI assistant for all entities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Most coordination runs on email and chat; incident response must not depend on it
manual_workaround: Company mobile phones and the out-of-band conferencing service; branch phones
quantified_impact_basis: Productivity loss across corporate and branch staff
